texts: EnvaDure is the premier, brand-agnostic technical advisory translating complex building science into highly customized, environmentally synced waterproofing specifications for desired structural durability & optimized asset life cycle value.
Unlike typical specification routes, We operate on radical brand neutrality.
We do not sell waterproofing products , We engineer risk out of the structure.
Our allegiance is solely to the structure, maintaining balance between project owner’s   interests and environment.
Why do project owners need a specialist waterproofing consultant ?
Building Codes may not always mandate,  but now increasingly recommend specialist-level guidance in system design.
Roofs are Getting Larger and More Complex
But Why Are We Building 21st-century Structures Using 20th-century Specifications…..
And In A Fundamentally Altered Climate ?
India Experienced a 15 fold Increase in Extreme Heat Wave Days Across          Mar- May & Jun-Sept Past 3 Decades
1.4 X times Rise in Extreme Rainfall Events in Last 5 Years
4 – 7 x increase in heatwave days by 2050 can be potentially experienced by major Indian cities

Dampness from external walls that spoil interior finishes ,
Dark dingy unsafe feeling car parks, etc.

Immediately transition toward high-performance specification designs supported by robustly engineered products that are correctly applied to reliably perform in these conditions !
Why do Leakages take place after execution ?
All these factors are responsible in various ways
Our analysis of  ~ 150 projects revealed this !!
Wrong System Selection or Incorrect Specification
Post application Damage due to improper sequence clarity
Improper Substrate due to deficient specification clarity
A glaring 48 % of leakages were taking place due to Application issues .
Next largest reason 45% was incorrect or deficient specification or wrong system selection.
Shows importance of correct system selection by a reliable Waterproofing Specialist
From the Analysis its Clear that Buildings Leak due to 5 fundamental reasons :
Missed out areas of a structure that haven’t been waterproofed.
Wrong Systems Selection or Deficient Specifications
Points 1 & 2 - Account for Nearly 45% of Failures, Remaining 3 Account for 55% cases
Wrong Systems Selection or Deficient Specifications
No thought of local climate, geotechnical/
1. Missed out areas of a structure that haven’t been waterproofed -
Why this happens and resultant problems :
Only standard surfaces ( like roofs , toilets , tanks, basement) considered while drafting BOQ – No in-depth study of project’s drawings to identify vulnerable that need waterproofing

Post award , Cost increases due to extra items getting executed at much higher prices – Typically what costs Re. 1/- during initial design phase estimation – can cost  Rs. 2/- if identified later during execution and can cost upto Rs. 10/- as repair costs post hand-over.
Missed BOQ items or lack of scope clarity can result in potential disputes between Client , contractors, PMC
Developer’s brand image adversely impacted due – customer’s carry perception that critical areas seem omitted

Detailed engineering study of architectural and structural drawings , soil investigation report , geographical factors, planned usage , construction technique, future maintenance factors etc for holistic risk assessment to identify all locations that need waterproofing.
Aligned BOQ item list arrived at post detailed study, minimises risk of extra items and missed scope.
Architectural drawings marked up with locations that need waterproofing for easy correlation with BOQ items.
Why this happens and resultant problems :
Lack of subject matter expertise with BOQ drafting team makers.
Adopting a copy paste approach of using one project’s BOQ across multiple projects without evaluating each individual project’s requirements.

Insufficiently drafted BOQ specifications that don’t provide clarity to bidders or project management teams – At times BOQ has a mix of multi brand based specs that creates confusion as specification intent isn’t clear.
Product manufacturer led BOQ can favour a specific brand – depriving client of a fair bidding process for best value option.
An independent brand agnostic neutral approach only driven by the project’s requirements.
A scientific approach towards fit for purpose based specifications design based on Indian and International standards and best practices.
Value engineered , Durability and Sustainability driven thought process.
Project biased and not product biased philosophy at the core.
No commercial involvement in entire process of bidding.
Why this happens and resultant problems :
Untrained workmen , Insufficient supervision – outcome of selecting a waterproofing contractor only basis L1 pricing without a proper PQ process.
Project execution teams not knowing what to check , how to check and when to check during application
Specifications unclear about dealing with complex locations such as penetrations , interfaces , profile etc

No project specific customised cross section drawings available to enable waterproofing contractor and project team to understand intricacy of the waterproofing system installation & build-up at critical points.

4. Damage to the waterproofing by other agencies –
Why this happens and resultant problems :
Due to lack of proper activity sequence clarity in the specifications /method statements & unclear HOTO process between agencies.
Lack of clarity in specifications about how to protect, when to protect and who will do the protection to completed waterproofing.

Detailed method statements that defined sequential activity with clarity of time intervals involved in succeeding activities.
Why this happens and resultant problems :

The unique EnvaDure Seven-Dimensional  Specification Design Approach Matrix
The Science: Analysis of soil geochemistry (pH levels, sulfate/chloride concentrations, etc  and hydrological dynamics (static hydraulic pressure  vs. dynamic perched water tables).
The Specification Impact: Choosing a membrane that can withstand high chemical attacks without depolymerizing.

The Science: Tailoring the dry-envelope requirement based on interior usage classes (e.g., Grade 1 for basements with open parking structures vs. Grade 3 for hyper-sensitive data centers or habitable basements with offices or shops ).
The Specification Impact: Designing multi-tier redundant barrier systems (Type A barrier + Type B integral + Type C drained protection) for critical zones.
The Science: Designing for solar exposure, UV degradation rates, temperature fluctuations ( ), wind-driven rain vectors, and thermal expansion-contraction cycles.
The Specification Impact: Specifying high-elasticity, crack-bridging liquid membranes in high-thermal fluctuation zones vs. robust sheet membranes for subterranean, temperature-stable basements.
The Science: Aligning the waterproofing barrier with insulation components (value requirements) and vapor control layers to prevent interstitial condensation.
The Specification Impact: Specifying cool-roof, highly reflective waterproofing coatings to lower building HVAC energy consumption.
The Science: Optimizing initial capital expenditure ( ) versus long-term operational and remedial maintenance expenditures.

The Specification Impact: Recommending a hybrid system—spending premium dollars on inaccessible, critical below-grade areas while utilizing highly cost-effective, easily repairable systems for above-grade podiums.
The Science: Reducing VOC emissions, utilizing recycled polymer content, and optimizing the carbon footprint of the waterproofing system over its lifetime.
The Specification Impact: Prioritizing solvent-free, non-toxic, and LEED-compliant systems that do not contaminate local groundwater systems.
The Science: Matching the service life expectancy of the waterproofing system with the design life of the structural concrete
The Specification Impact: Eliminating materials with a high rate of early-onset oxidation or embrittlement to prevent premature structural decay.
